gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.
